title: NovaItems
description: A modern Minecraft plugin for creating custom items, blocks, furniture, and your own content without a complicated setup.
body:
# NovaItems

**A modern custom content engine for Minecraft servers running on Paper/Purpur 1.21.x (Java 21).**

**NovaItems makes it easy to create:**

- 🧱 Custom items
- 🪑 Furniture & decorations
- 🧩 Custom blocks
- ⚒ Crafting recipes
- 🎨 Automatic resource packs
- 🖥 GUI editors
- 🔌 Developer API

**The plugin is modular, optimized, and suitable for survival, RPG, and network servers.**
## ✨ Integrations

- PlaceholderAPI
- LuckPerms
- Vault
- WorldEdit
- WorldGuard
- MythicMobs
- MMOItems
- Script
- GriefPrevention
- Lands

## 📦 Compatibility

- Paper 1.21.x
- Purpur 1.21.x
- Java 21

## 📖 Commands

- /novaitems                Main command
- /novaitems reload         Reload plugin
- /novaitems give            Give item
- /novaitems editor            GUI editor

## 🔐 Permissions

- novaitems.admin
- novaitems.reload
- novaitems.give
- novaitems.editor

## 🛠 Troubleshooting

- Check if players have accepted the resource pack
- Use Paper/Purpur 1.21.x
- Rebuild the resource pack after an update

NovaItems is designed for easy setup, high performance, and a modern custom content workflow.
